affiliations.role_title: Army first lieutenant and reconnaissance boat officer
affiliations.research_notes: Official Navy history documents Peddicord leading graduates during Operation Torch in November 1942. Later official NPS history identifies him as an OSS major in 1944. The accessible sources do not prove this was his immediate pre-OSS assignment.

Norwich's 1939 student newspaper identifies Pedrick as a Class of 1942 cadet. The 1947 class record gives an OSS service start in June 1942, making the student-to-OSS sequence strongly date bounded. Norwich is an institutional affiliation, not an employer.
The University of California memorial states that Peiss was appointed to Harvard College Library after graduating in 1938 and was called into OSS service in 1943.

A wartime OSS interview says Paledes operated his own grocery store in civilian life, entered the Army in September 1941, and was assigned to OSS in October 1943. The store is therefore the documented last civilian occupation before Army service, not the immediate pre-OSS affiliation.
